IFM was created to remind women that it’s never too late to learn about finance. 

As women, we manage careers, kids and households but feel too intimidated to manage our money. It’s not because we’re not smart enough, but because nobody taught us patiently. 

IFM is here to change exactly that. We make finance fun, engaging and easy through simple explanations, everyday analogies and jargon-free examples. 

Join IFM to secure your financial future 💰✨

IFM wasn’t created on a whim - it came as a result of lived experience.

Even as a business journalist, I, like most women, was left out of money conversations and eventually learnt to tune myself out too. 

But not anymore. I created IFM to catch us up and tune us back in.

Because financial confidence doesn’t come from being an expert, it comes from finally taking charge of your future 🤍

Every time you read a headline saying someone became “₹1,000 crore richer” or “lost billions overnight,” it doesn’t mean that money suddenly appeared in or disappeared from their bank account.

Most of the time, it’s their net worth that’s changed because the value of what they own has gone up or down.

The goal isn’t just to earn more money. It’s to slowly build assets that can grow your net worth over time. 🌱

Because wealth isn’t only about your income, it’s also about what you own.

💛 Save this for the next time you see one of those headlines.

Before you hit Buy Now, ask yourself:
Am I buying this because I can truly afford it or because the moment is convincing me that I can?

Sometimes, the best financial habit isn’t spending less, it’s pausing long enough to spend intentionally.

We often grow up believing that earning more is the only way to build wealth.

But wealth isn’t just a result of how much you make, it’s also shaped by what you do with the money you earn.

The earlier you learn this, the more time your money has to do what it’s meant to do,grow.

What’s one money lesson you wish you had learned sooner? Share it in the comments. 💬

A big profit number can look impressive. But it doesn’t always tell you the full story.

Understanding company results means looking beyond what happened and asking what could happen next. Are sales growing? Is the business becoming more efficient? What is management saying? And where could future growth come from?

Because profit tells you about the past. But investing also means learning to understand the future. 📈
Save this for the next earnings season. 💙

It’s not about the coffee ☕️

That daily expense may not seem significant today. But it’s worth asking yourself: Could a small portion of that money also be working towards your future?

Wealth isn’t built overnight. It’s built through consistency, patience, and the power of compounding.

The goal isn’t to give up your lifestyle, it’s to make sure your money is helping you create the life you want tomorrow, too.

That’s why IFM exists - to bust the myths and create financially confident women, one step at a time. ⚡💖
